summary: GPT-5.5 retired from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in.
Temporary +50% weekly-limit boost ended; permanent +25% over baseline began — Anthropic's own figure: a 17% reduction vs prior level. Announced 2026-08-29.
Legacy Enterprise Auto flat per-token rate ended; Auto bills at routed model's list price.
Promotional included credits for Business ($30) and Enterprise ($70) ended; back to $19/$39.
Individual & Teams plans moved to routed-model pricing; included Cursor Models limits raised (no figure published).
Cloud and AI dollar balances merged into one credit balance; 20 Cloud + 4 AI credits/mo grants. Headline prices unchanged.
Included usage for Cursor models (Auto, Composer 2.5) doubled, per Cursor staff on X.
Teams: separate first-party and third-party pools; Standard $40/mo ($32 annual), new Premium seat $120/mo ($96 annual) with 5x usage.
All plans moved to usage-based GitHub AI Credits replacing premium requests; Pro/Pro+ get flex allotments; new Max plan $100/mo.
